test_cases.name: Normal Case - Immediate Confirmed Availability
test_cases.description: Standard inventory check returning immediate confirmed availability
acceptance_criteria: v1: Returns 200 with available=true
v2: Returns 200 with available=true and availabilityStatus=confirmed
Quantities match or v2 shows inventory at same warehouse level

test_cases.name: Boundary Case - Zero Inventory
test_cases.description: Edge case where inventory quantity is exactly zero
acceptance_criteria: v1: Returns available=false when quantity=0
v2: Returns available=false with availabilityStatus=out_of_stock
Both consistently mark as unavailable
test_cases.pass_condition: Both return available=false, status reflects zero inventory

test_cases.name: Asynchronous/Partial Case - Pending Status with Polling
test_cases.description: API returns pending status indicating eventual consistency; test polling mechanism
acceptance_criteria: v1: Returns null values for in-progress inventory
v2: Returns 202 Accepted with pending status and pollingUrl
Service polls v2 endpoint and receives updated data
After polling, v2 returns confirmed availability
test_cases.pass_condition: v2 polling completes within 3 retries, final status confirmed

test_cases.name: Invalid/Malformed Input - Missing regionId
test_cases.description: v2 API requires regionId parameter; test error handling for missing parameter
acceptance_criteria: v1: Request succeeds (no regionId required)
v2: Request fails with 400 Bad Request
Service detects missing regionId and returns error to caller
Service has fallback or error handling strategy
test_cases.pass_condition: v2 error caught, service returns graceful error response

test_cases.name: High-Latency / Error Case - Timeout and Retry
test_cases.description: Test handling of upstream API timeout and retry logic with exponential backoff

body.message: Upstream service did not respond within 5 seconds
Upstream service did not respond within 5 seconds

acceptance_criteria: v1: Handles timeout gracefully or returns error
v2: Implements retry logic with exponential backoff
v2: Eventually succeeds after 2-3 retries
Service tracks retry count and logs retry attempts
Fallback strategy handles max retries exceeded
test_cases.pass_condition: v2 succeeds after retries, latency tracked, retry count correct

test_cases.name: Backward Compatibility - Feature Flag Toggle
test_cases.description: Service can toggle between v1 and v2 API using feature flag without code changes
acceptance_criteria: Feature flag 'use_v2_api' controls which endpoint is called
When flag=false: calls v1 endpoint, returns v1 format
When flag=true: calls v2 endpoint, translates to consistent output format
Same business logic applies regardless of flag state
test_cases.pass_condition: Both flag states execute, results converge to same availability decision
